=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py:640-651 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test expects `NOOP_RECOVERY_FINGERPRINT_CAP_STALE_SUPPORT` in the output, but the inline-quoted cap marker is not recognized by the line-anchored regex, so `N_NOOP_CAP_AUTHORS` is empty and the entire cap-marker logic block is skipped.
  WHY: The fixture places the cap marker inside backticks on a "**First error:**" line. The line-anchored regex `(^|\\n)<!-- review-autofix-failure-cap:v1 head=...` requires the marker to start at the beginning of a line. An inline-quoted marker fails this check, so `jq` returns an empty author list. The condition `if [ -n "${N_NOOP_CAP_AUTHORS}" ]` at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26158` is false, the cap-marker block is skipped, and the PR is dispatched without emitting any `NOOP_RECOVERY_*` log.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
